content.response_text:
**Claim TM‑2026‑0061 – Status Summary (as of 23 Sep 2026)** | Item | Detail | |------|--------| | **Reference** | TM‑2026‑0061 | | **Policy** | TM‑CP‑118460 (Commercial Property – Fire) | | **Policyholder** | Halstead Joinery Limited | | **Incident Date** | 2 April 2026 | | **Status** | **Open** (large‑loss claim, escalated on notification) | | **Reserve (GBP)** | £214,000 | | **Paid to Date (GBP)** | £60,000 | | **Handler** | Large Loss Unit | | **Handling Note** | • Fire in the dust‑extraction plant, cause confirmed as a failed bearing.
• Hot‑work permit records requested and supplied.
• Business‑interruption claim running concurrently.
• Re‑insurance notified on 3 April 2026. | ### Next Steps (recommended) 1. **Finalise Loss Estimate** - Confirm the current loss estimate with the loss adjuster and obtain any additional evidence (e.g., updated repair invoices, expert witness reports). - Prepare a detailed engineering report for the reinsurer, referencing policy wording and the “cause established as a failed bearing” note. 2. **Business‑Interruption Claim** - Submit the business‑interruption claim (running alongside the property loss) and ensure the reinstated revenue figures are aligned with the policy’s definition of “loss of profit.” - Liaise with the client’s accounts team to verify the period covered (12‑month indemnity period). 3. **Re‑insurance Liaison** - Review the re‑insurance notification (date 3 April 2026) and confirm that all required documentation (hot‑work permit records, cause analysis) has been forwarded. - Set a follow‑up date with the reinsurer to track their response and any additional requirements. 4. **Documentation & Record‑Keeping** - Update the case file with any new evidence obtained (e.g., photographs, engineering drawings). - Log all communications (emails, calls) with the reinsurer and Halstead Joinery in the case file store. - Create a brief status note (e.g., “Claim TM‑2026‑0061 – Large Loss – Reserve £214k, Paid £60k – Next steps: finalize engineering report, submit business‑interruption claim, follow‑up re‑insurance.”) and store it in the case note store. 5. **Client Update** - Prepare a brief update letter for Halstead Joinery outlining the current status, reserve amount, and the upcoming steps, referencing the policy’s business‑interruption provision and re‑insurance obligations. 6. **Timeline Review** - Set a milestone reminder for **15 Oct 2026** to ensure the engineering report and business‑interruption claim are submitted to the reinsurer, aligning with their typical turnaround expectations. These actions will keep the claim on track, satisfy the reinsurer’s documentation requirements, and provide Halstead Joinery with clear visibility into the next phases of the settlement process.
